news.title: Future biology teacher looks forward to trip to Italy through Global Gateway program
news.summary_en: Abigail Hellums always wanted to be a teacher. Now as she pursues a major in secondary education with a concentration in biology, Hellums will also add to her teaching experiences with a trip to Italy next spring as part of the Global Gateway for Teachers program.

news.title: Faculty connect with educators to learn more about special education in India
news.summary_en: Associate Professor Sarah Hurwitz and Professor Adam Maltese visited India over the summer for an event with IU Gateway and visits to schools, all in an effort to discuss how to better educate students with disabilities. They met with India policymakers, ministers of education, and leaders of disability groups, among others.
